title: The Borrowed Verdict Again
author: Coral Nystrom
blurb: Coral Ravensworth, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
